title: 第21章 太古祖龙之灵第22章 老六叶辰
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 真龙秘境深处中
地底几百米处，凌浩与六十四帝卫纷纷都被眼前巨大的骨骸震惊到了，看着眼前的庞然大物，发现自己是多么渺小如同蚂蚁面对一只上古猛虎
呜呜呜~
白泽趴在地上不断的发出恐惧的跌声，整个身子都在颤抖，不敢抬头正视眼前的太古祖龙，哪怕它已经死去数亿年，但它身上散发的威压始终存在，哪怕只是千分之一的威压也不是一只幼年的白泽能承担的起的
“神子，没想到我们竟然能发现这个太古祖龙，老天对我们凌家的眷顾啊”
帝一高兴的笑着道，这么大的太古祖龙的骨骸要是带回凌家，不知道可以打造多少高阶皇阶仙器，甚至圣阶，帝阶也不是没有这个可能，这对于凌家将是一个巨大的提升
“嗯，将这个太古祖龙的骨骸收了，待回家族的时候交给负责炼器的五长老”
凌浩也是满意的看着眼前庞大的骨骸，内心也是十分的激动，但更没想到的是叶辰的造化竟然这么丰富，这才可是便宜我了嘿嘿嘿
“喂喂喂，小鬼，我的骨骸你们可不能就这么简单的就带走了”
突然在太古祖龙的身上传来一道娇嫩且带萌娃的声音传出来
“谁！！出来”
帝一瞬移站到凌浩的身前警惕的看向周围道，身上仙圣的修为瞬间笼罩整个山洞，而身后的六十三帝卫纷纷围在凌浩的周围警惕四周，生怕凌浩出什么事情
“唉唉唉，谎个鸡毛啊，你们想带走本祖的骨骸还不允许本祖说话啦”
此时庞大的骨骸上出现一束紫色的光芒，一只体型幼小的龙出现在凌浩等人面前道，整个身体呈紫色，背上挥舞着两只巴掌大的翅膀，头上长着两只珊瑚大小的龙角，娇嫩的脸蛋再加是两个小小的虎牙甚是可爱
“嗯？你是？”
凌浩看着眼前的紫色小龙人道，但却不敢确定它就是太古祖龙，毕竟太古祖龙寻常是不可能现身的
随后挥挥手让六十四帝卫放松警惕，而白泽则是被吓的晕在地上，脚不断的抽抽，看的凌浩直摸额头，不争气的玩意儿
“你个小娃娃还问本祖是谁？我就你们眼前的太古祖龙，还不赶紧跪下磕头？”
娇小的太古祖龙抬头挺胸的看着凌浩道，整只龙都贼神气，就连我这个作者都想干它，然后扔进茅坑里
“什么！！你就是太古祖龙？”
凌浩惊讶的看着眼前的太古祖龙道，内心对叶辰的造化甚是满意，叶辰啊叶辰想不到你才区区炼气期就可以得到一只太古祖龙的帮助，难怪你的成就如此之高，不过现在是我的了
“当然，如果不是看你是身具混沌青莲体，本祖才懒得出现呢”
太古祖龙神气的飞到凌浩的身前道，其实内心可不是这样想的，毕竟眼前的人可是要带走它的骨骸呢，不然它以后还怎么生活啊
“哦，你竟然能看出我身具混沌青莲体”
凌浩笑着看着眼前的太古祖龙道，从下界到现在他始终都是用圣阶仙器来掩盖自己的气息，大罗金仙以下的修士是不可能发现的了，除非他主动暴露出来
“当然，你身上那个破铜烂铁不可能瞒得过本祖”
太古祖龙飞到凌浩的肩膀神气的道，想当初自己麾下的各种仙器数不胜数
但太古祖龙也看的出凌浩所佩戴的是乃是圣阶高级仙器，想必来头肯定不小，在三千大世界里家族肯定是霸主级别的存在，说不定能带本祖去往那个地方也说不定呢，换做以前自己肯定看不上，但如今形势所迫，不得已而为之
content_en:
Deep in the secret realm of the true dragon
A few hundred meters underground, Ling Hao and the Sixty-Four Emperor Guards were shocked by the huge skeleton in front of them. Looking at the huge thing in front of them, they realized how small they were, like ants facing an ancient tiger.
Woohoo~
Bai Ze lay on the ground and kept making fearful falling sounds. His whole body was shaking. He didn't dare to raise his head and look at the ancient ancestral dragon in front of him. Even though it had been dead for hundreds of millions of years, the pressure it exuded was always there. Even if it was only one thousandth of the pressure, it was not something a young Bai Ze could bear.
"Son of God, I didn't expect that we would be able to discover this ancient ancestral dragon. What a blessing from God to our Ling family."
Di Yi smiled happily and said, if the bones of such a large ancient ancestral dragon were brought back to the Ling family, I don't know how many high-level imperial-level immortal weapons can be made, even holy-level, emperor-level is not impossible. This will be a huge improvement for the Ling family.
"Well, collect the bones of this ancient ancestral dragon and hand them over to the fifth elder in charge of weapon refining when he returns to the family."
Ling Hao also looked at the huge skeleton in front of him with satisfaction, and was very excited inside. But what he didn't expect was that Ye Chen's fortune was so rich. This is an advantage for me. Hehehe
"Hey, hey, kid, you can't just take my bones away like that."
Suddenly, a delicate and cute voice came from the ancient ancestral dragon.
"Who!! Come out"
Emperor Yi teleported to stand in front of Ling Hao and looked around with vigilance. The cultivation of the Immortal Saint on his body instantly enveloped the entire cave, and the sixty-three emperor guards behind him gathered around Ling Hao and were vigilant, fearing that something would happen to Ling Hao.
"Alas, what a stupid lie. You want to take away my ancestor's bones but you don't allow me to speak."
At this time, a beam of purple light appeared on the huge skeleton, and a young dragon appeared in front of Ling Hao and others. Its whole body was purple, with two palm-sized wings waving on its back, and two coral-sized dragon horns on its head. Its delicate face and two small tiger teeth were very cute.
"Huh? You are?"
Ling Hao looked at the purple little dragon in front of him and said, but he was not sure that it was the ancient ancestral dragon. After all, it is impossible for the ancient ancestral dragon to appear normally.
Then he waved his hand to tell the 64 Emperor Guards to relax their vigilance, while Bai Ze was so frightened that he fainted on the ground, his feet kept twitching, and Ling Hao looked at him and touched his forehead.
"You little kid, you still ask me who my ancestor is? I am the ancient ancestral dragon in front of you, why don't you kneel down and kowtow?"
The petite ancient ancestral dragon raised his head and looked at Ling Hao and said, the whole dragon is so awesome that even I, the author, want to fuck it and then throw it into the pit.
"What!! Are you the Ancient Ancestral Dragon?"
Ling Hao looked at the ancient ancestral dragon in front of him in surprise. He was very satisfied with Ye Chen's creation. Ye Chen, Ye Chen never thought that you could get help from an ancient ancestral dragon when you were only in the Qi refining stage. No wonder your achievements are so high, but now you are mine.
"Of course, if it weren't for the fact that you have a chaotic green lotus body, I wouldn't bother to show up."
The ancient ancestral dragon flew in front of Ling Hao and said, in fact, that was not what he was thinking in his heart. After all, the person in front of him wanted to take away its bones, otherwise how could it live in the future?
"Oh, you can actually see that I have a chaotic green lotus body."
Ling Hao smiled and looked at the ancient ancestor Long Dao in front of him. From the lower world to the present, he has always used holy-level immortal weapons to cover up his aura. It is impossible for monks below Daluo Jinxian to discover it unless he takes the initiative to expose it.
"Of course, it's impossible to hide that scrap of metal on your body from me."
The ancient ancestral dragon flew to Ling Hao's shoulder and said proudly, thinking that he had countless immortal weapons under his command.
But the ancient ancestral dragon could also see that what Ling Hao was wearing was a high-level holy-level immortal weapon. He must have a lot of background. In the three thousand worlds, the family must be an overlord-level existence. He might be able to take his ancestor to that place. In the past, he would have looked down on him, but now the situation forced him to do it.
